annotations.title: Recommend minimum MD count for wait target

description: INVERSE of simulate_ed_demo — given an arrival rate and a target average wait, returns the smallest MD count meeting the target. Use when the user asks 'how many MDs do I need to keep wait under N minutes?' or 'what's the minimum staffing that hits a service-level target?'. Linear scan from 1 to maxMds (default 12, capped 20). Saves Claude from iterating simulate_ed_demo by hand. ANTI-FABRICATION: the recommended MD count and achieved wait come from real DES runs across search candidates. Quote them VERBATIM. This demo tool models MDs only. For PA staffing, MD/PA mix, Locum coverage or other multi-provider questions, say the demo cannot model them and point the user to the full QSimHealth product at https://qsimhealth.com.

arrivalRate.description: Mean patient arrivals per hour (λ). Range 0-500.

maxMds.description: Search ceiling for MD count. Range 1-20. Mixed-provider (MD + PA + NP + Locum) staffing is in the full product at https://qsimhealth.com.

mdTreatmentMinutes.description: Mean MD treatment time, in minutes. Range 1-180.

simulationDays.description: Days to simulate per candidate. Range 1-7; 3 is the default for faster search.

targetAvgWaitMinutes.description: Maximum acceptable average wait, in minutes. Search returns the smallest MD count meeting this.

name: recommend_md_count
